description: Owner request 2026-11-12: simulate the 10,193 profile pairs (19,647 displayed cells) whose published 2026 outcome was rule-inferred (result index evidenceType 'inferred', source first-pass-inference), so every cell gets real outcomes and remaining-HP/survivor data. Same pinned 2026 inputs: frozen 2026 mechanics bundle, the five frozen arena scenarios, 27-unit geometric-cost battle rules, frozen-civ-matchups-v3 engine. Orientation = the published 2026 results table, so each context is the exact stored context of its serving-DB evidence row (verified by `python -m aoe2x.matchups.inferred_2026 verify inferred-2026-resim`). Sampling = the 2026 forecast campaign's one-three-ten: seed 0 alone is accepted only when it agrees with the prior (the rule-inferred outcome), the loser is wiped out and the winner keeps >= 25% HP; otherwise seeds 0-2, then 3-9 on mixed winners. Selection and priors files are generated outside git by `python -m aoe2x.matchups.inferred_2026 build` from the 2026 result index (sha256 d672f226...). Results are for owner review only; nothing feeds the website DB. Operator note: aoe2x/matchups/RUN_INFERRED_2026.md.
